note: Sidebar tabs are client outcomes. The four site outcomes come first; the ten Workflow Automation (RPA) tabs follow, grouped on Overview as a Record → Build → Run pipeline. The request's build checklist (connections, keys in Settings, demo data, overview visual) is met across these tabs, the Overview centrepiece and HQ's Settings/Connections screens, not as tabs of its own.

panes.title: Site documents
panes.composition: Arrivals list grouped into Last hour / Earlier today / Before today with filter chips; rail: headline number + waiting/failed chips + Scan button, watched folder (path, monitor state, collapsible admin editor), file-type mix bars, 24-hour arrivals trend (total, peak, full-width plot). On phones the headline card comes first, above the list.

panes.title: Contractor file transfers
panes.composition: Full-width sync band: headline number and chips, Sync button and direction control, and a flow diagram Site ⇄ Contractor FTP with counts and volume each way (inactive direction drawn dashed). Then the failure card (white, red edge) beside the 24-hour trend from 900px, then the full-width paged transfer timeline. The direction control is labelled.

panes.title: Project inbox
panes.composition: Full-width triage band: headline number, one proportional bar of where mail went (series colours, labelled legend), and the Check button. Below: paged message queue with rule filter (rules, No rule, Unreadable) beside a rail: rules with colour swatches matching the bar, match counts and a collapsible rule editor; the mailbox card; who writes most.

panes.title: Activity record
panes.composition: Three tiles (record size + integrity with Check and Export CSV; events by source; what is stored, in plain words) over a full-width ledger with source and result filters (both counted), sources in plain words (Site folder, FTP, Inbox, Schedule), each event split into a muted source prefix and readable text, paged 15 at a time; two lines per event on phones.

panes.title: Record a workflow
panes.composition: Recorder console (Record mode chip, start form or live watcher with Stop/Discard, then save-as-workflow), 'What the recorder sees' (latest capture large), captured steps (step, action, target, screenshot); rail: what is kept (privacy rules + counters) and recent recordings. Phone rows are compact cards.
panes.empty: Nothing captured yet. Start a recording and do the task.

panes.title: Typed inputs
panes.composition: Three count tiles (as recorded / variable / secret; still three across on phones as compact numbers), then the full-width list of everything typed with a row key under the picker, each with its next action, and typing still waiting in unsaved recordings.

panes.title: Apps & pages
panes.composition: Full-width route band (each app switch and page change as a stop on a line, last replay state), 'Where the screen had changed' (red edge when replays missed something), then each stop as a card with its steps and a folded address editor. Long page addresses wrap; nothing scrolls sideways on phones.
panes.empty: This workflow has no steps yet.

panes.title: Step screenshots
panes.composition: Source picker, coverage bar and row key, then a contact sheet of every step (2 across on phones, 2 from 640px, 3 from 1100px); for runs, replayed screen beside the recorded one.

panes.title: Workflows
panes.composition: Recordings ready to become workflows, the library (client filter for the owner), the chosen workflow's card (chips, links to editor/order/variables/run, description, a folded 'Rename, describe, duplicate or delete' form, give a copy to a client, recent runs); rail (sticky from 720px): Schedule and Trigger, chip On/Paused/Off, a plain sentence first with its form folded once set.
panes.empty: No workflows yet. Record a task, or create an empty workflow below.

panes.title: Step editor
panes.composition: Steps list with rename-in-place and edit; sticky rail with the focused step's screenshot and links.

panes.title: Order & checkpoints
panes.composition: Vertical flow Start → Done: drag, nudge or send a step to a position; approval gates between steps with what to check.
panes.empty: This workflow has no steps yet.

panes.title: Variables
panes.composition: Main: one card per variable (2 across) and the binding table (which step types which variable, suggestions); rail: Add a variable, Logins from Connections.
panes.empty: No variables yet: every step types exactly what was recorded.

panes.title: Run a workflow
panes.composition: Start band (workflow, its variables, Start run, Stop everything), then the live run: progress dots, Stop, approval box when a checkpoint waits, steps with screenshots beside the current screen, recent runs, log. Refreshes every 1.5 s while live.
panes.empty: No workflows yet. Record a task first, then run it here.

panes.title: Run history
panes.composition: Summary (success rate, chips), 24-hour runs and results charts, then the filterable run list (8 per page on phones, 12 on wide) beside a sticky details rail: 'Runs that need a look' until one is chosen, then its error, steps with screenshots, log, Continue from the failed step / Run again. On phones the rail comes first.
panes.empty: No runs yet. Start one in Run a workflow.
